description: Execute one Launch Agent V1 approved developer tool directly with a verbatim argument array. Command interpreters, pipelines, redirections, and script text are not supported.

command.description: Approved developer-tool name, absolute executable path, or a whitespace-separated invocation such as 'git status --short'. Prefer parameters for arguments that must remain a single value.
command.name: command

parameters.description: Verbatim process arguments. Each array item is passed as one argument.
parameters.name: parameters

name: shell_call
